p.src: 1  Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!

en: Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!
u.src: 1  Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!

p.src: 2  Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!

en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!
u.src: 2  Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!

p.src: 3  May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.

en: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
u.src: 3  May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
